market_view: Calm VIX (16.6) but oil spiking on the Iran war and Red Sea attacks pushed the 10-year to 4.66%, the highest since January 2025; new tariffs add noise. Earnings season adds variance.

oil_gas.reasoning: Brent near 94-100 and XOM +6.9% in 5 days already price the escalation; a driver move that happened is not a forecast, and a de-escalation headline could reverse it quickly. No durable edge.

gold_miners.reasoning: NEM Q2 beat with steady output guidance is public and was a modest surprise at most. Gold is 22% below its peak, yields at a 1.5-year high and a firm dollar are headwinds. No named edge.

chips.reasoning: AMD's AI rack news and its Anthropic deal are AMD-specific; NVDA has no catalyst of its own. Sector ETF is down 5.7% in 20 days, and rising yields hurt long-duration names. Big tech earnings add variance only.

pharma.reasoning: Positive retatrutide Phase 3 results are good news but were widely expected and likely priced in; LLY is already up 31% in 60 days. Earnings variance ahead; no clear mispricing.

copper_uranium.reasoning: FCX jumped 3.9% in one day and copper was mixed. The headlines (Saudi enrichment deal, copper theft, a scintillator paper) do not move FCX. No catalyst I can name.

would_change_my_mind: A concrete company-specific surprise in the Q2 earnings (XOM, NVDA, LLY, FCX) or a clear Hormuz or Fed shock that is not yet in prices.

handoff.what_changed: Oil escalated further: WTI 86.8 (+9% in 5 days), Brent 94 and headlines of $100 after Red Sea and tanker attacks. The 10-year yield rose to 4.66%, the highest since January 2025. NEM beat Q2 estimates and LLY reported positive retatrutide Phase 3 results; all families stay flat.

oil_gas.why: XOM is +6.9% in 5 days and the escalation is priced in; no durable edge.

gold_miners.why: NEM's Q2 beat is public, while high yields and a firm dollar weigh on gold, which is 22% below its peak.

chips.why: AMD-specific news only; no NVDA catalyst and rising yields are a headwind.

pharma.why: Retatrutide Phase 3 success was expected and LLY is already up 31% in 60 days.

copper_uranium.why: No FCX-specific catalyst; copper is mixed and the uranium headlines do not reach FCX.

handoff.next_job: Next decision day: read the handoff, re-check the five families, and look for concrete catalysts (Q2 earnings of XOM, NVDA, LLY, FCX, the jobs report, Iran or Red Sea escalation or a deal). Stay flat unless a named reason appears.
